model.feature_importance_scope: Standardized logistic-component coefficients; not full-ensemble importance or causal effects.
model.calibration_note: Probabilities are model estimates and have not been separately calibrated. Holdout reliability bins measure agreement with outcomes; they do not apply a calibration transform.
model.weight_selection: Validation accuracy minus 0.25 times Brier score, transformed to softmax weights; the logistic component is capped before normalization. The final chronological holdout does not choose these weights.
model.description: 6 fitted estimators combine 37 pre-bout inputs. Serving models: Extra Trees, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, HistGradientBoosting, Logistic Regression.
model.limitations: Chronological replay reduces outcome leakage. Historical source completeness and the timestamps of imported attributes are not independently audited. Missing inputs use baseline values.
